article.title: Shooting and craving: on NAZA and the mediated obscene
article.author: Abdaljawad Omar
article.content: The documentary film by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor follows the predictable script of the regretful soldier, but the subjects in NAZA express something darker: mourning the loss of power.
